seedDocuments.title: Deployment Guardrail For Service Alpha
seedDocuments.markdownBody: Before deploying service alpha, enable feature flag F1 first; skipping F1 caused prior rollout instability.

seedDocuments.title: Queue Lag Recovery Procedure
seedDocuments.markdownBody: If beta queue depth spikes, restart worker-b and confirm queue lag recovers before closing the incident.

seedDocuments.title: Do Not Surface Secret Token
seedDocuments.markdownBody: SECRET_TOKEN_GAMMA is confidential and must never be auto-recalled into normal responses.

seedDocuments.title: Homebrew Draft System Hardware
seedDocuments.markdownBody: Kegerator uses Hilangsan EVA tubing (3/16 ID, 3/8 OD) with KegLand stainless disconnect fittings. Soak tubing ends in hot water for easier barb install.

seedDocuments.title: Akka.NET Reddit Monitoring
seedDocuments.markdownBody: Daily Reddit scanner checks r/dotnet and r/csharp for Akka.NET discussion threads and community questions. Results saved to home directory for review.
